title: Investing — AGI Fear Trade
summary: Capital: ~$700k-$800k mostly in crypto on Solana. Thesis: software goes to zero as AI rises, compute stays valuable, AGI fear drives flight to hard assets.

overview.what: Developing an investing thesis around the AGI transition. Core belief: as AI commoditizes software, compute/infra stays valuable. As AGI gets closer and UBI talk rises, people panic about permanent underclass — flight to hard assets and safety.
overview.status_detail: Thesis drafted. Currently mostly in crypto on Solana. Need to diversify non-crypto allocation and find specific investable positions.

columns.name: Sharpen the thesis
values: Turn draft thesis into specific investable ideas
Write out: what exactly triggers the fear trade? What's the timeline? What assets benefit?

columns.name: Non-crypto allocation
values: Where to put capital outside Solana
Research: compute ETFs, data center REITs, energy/power plays, gold/hard assets

columns.name: Specific positions
values: Find actual tickers/tokens to size into
Screen for: compute infra companies, AI picks-and-shovels, fear-trade hedges

columns.name: Risk management
values: Concentrated in crypto — what's the downside plan?
Define: max crypto allocation %, stop-loss rules, diversification targets

considerations.label: Concentration risk
considerations.detail: Mostly in crypto on Solana is high conviction but high risk. One bad cycle could cut capital significantly.

considerations.label: Timeline
considerations.detail: AGI fear trade might be 2-5 years out. Need positions that don't bleed while waiting.

considerations.label: Thesis risk
considerations.detail: What if software DOESN'T go to zero? What if AI augments rather than replaces? Need to stress-test the thesis.

considerations.label: Tax implications
considerations.detail: Moving from crypto to other assets triggers capital gains. Factor tax into any rebalancing plan.

notes:
The thesis in plain language:

1. Software companies lose moats as AI can generate code/products instantly
2. But AI needs compute — GPUs, data centers, energy. That layer stays valuable.
3. As AGI approaches, public fear grows. UBI discussions signal 'jobs are going away.'
4. People who feel threatened flee to perceived safety: hard assets, gold, crypto, land.
5. The 'AGI fear trade' is the macro bet on that panic.

Open questions:
- Is Solana the right crypto bet for this thesis, or should it be BTC (digital gold narrative)?
- Which compute companies are best positioned? (NVDA obvious but priced in?)
- Is there a way to play the fear directly? (VIX-related, put options on software companies?)
